title: Greeting, Divisions in the Church, Christ the Wisdom and Power of God

questions.question: Who joins Paul in greeting the church of God that is in Corinth?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:1 (ESV): "Paul, called by the will of God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and our brother Sosthenes,"

questions.question: Paul gives thanks to God always for the Corinthians because in every way they were enriched in him in all ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:4-5 (ESV): "I give thanks to my God always for you... that in every way you were enriched in him in all speech and all knowledge—"

questions.question: Paul writes that they are not lacking in any gift, as they wait for the revealing of our Lord Jesus Christ, who will sustain them to the end, guiltless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ. By whom were they called?
options: By the Spirit, who is holy
By the apostles, who were sent
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:9 (ESV): "God is faithful, by whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord."

questions.question: Paul appeals to the brothers by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of them agree, and that there be no ____ among them.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:10 (ESV): "I appeal to you, brothers, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree, and that there be no divisions among you,"

questions.question: From whose people did Paul receive a report that there is quarreling among the Corinthians?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:11 (ESV): "For it has been reported to me by Chloe's people that there is quarreling among you, my brothers."

questions.question: What were the factions in the Corinthian church saying?
options: "I follow Paul," "I follow Apollos," "I follow Cephas," "I follow Christ."
"I follow the law," "I follow grace," "I follow the Spirit," "I follow tradition."
"I am of the Jews," "I am of the Greeks," "I am of the Romans," "I am of the free."
"I follow Peter," "I follow James," "I follow John," "I follow Matthew."
questions.correctAnswer: "I follow Paul," "I follow Apollos," "I follow Cephas," "I follow Christ."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:12 (ESV): "What I mean is that each one of you says, 'I follow Paul,' or 'I follow Apollos,' or 'I follow Cephas,' or 'I follow Christ.'"

questions.question: Paul asks rhetorically, "Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you?" He then thanks God that he baptized none of them except whom?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:14 (ESV): "I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,"

questions.question: Paul states that Christ did not send him to baptize but to preach the gospel, and not with words of eloquent wisdom, lest what happen?
options: Lest the cross of Christ be emptied of its power
Lest he boast in his own speech
Lest the Corinthians be deceived by smooth words
Lest they follow human leaders instead of God
questions.correctAnswer: Lest the cross of Christ be emptied of its power
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:17 (ESV): "For Christ did not send me to baptize but to preach the gospel, and not with words of eloquent wisdom, lest the cross of Christ be emptied of its power."

questions.question: For the word of the cross is ____ to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:18 (ESV): "For the word of the cross is folly to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God."

questions.question: Paul quotes Isaiah: "I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and the discernment of the discerning I will ____."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:19 (ESV): "For it is written, 'I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and the discernment of the discerning I will thwart.'"

questions.question: For Jews demand signs and Greeks seek wisdom, but we preach ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:22-23 (ESV): "For Jews demand signs and Greeks seek wisdom, but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and folly to Gentiles,"

questions.question: Christ crucified is a stumbling block to Jews and ____ to Gentiles.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:23 (ESV): "but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and folly to Gentiles,"

questions.question: For the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the ____ of God is stronger than men.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:25 (ESV): "For the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men."

questions.question: Consider your calling, brothers: not many of you were wise according to worldly standards, not many were powerful, not many were of ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:26 (ESV): "For consider your calling, brothers: not many of you were wise according to worldly standards, not many were powerful, not many were of noble birth."

questions.question: God chose what is foolish in the world to shame the wise; God chose what is weak in the world to shame the strong. He did this so that no human being might ____ in the presence of God.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 1:27-29 (ESV): "But God chose what is foolish in the world to shame the wise; God chose what is weak in the world to shame the strong... so that no human being might boast in the presence of God."

key_verse_text: For the word of the cross is folly to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
